content:
Field
Description
ContextTimeStamp
System time of event creation.
IdpPolicyRuleId
The ID of the rule in the Identity Protection policy
IdpPolicyRuleName
The display name of the rule in the Identity Protection policy
SimulationMode
A flag to indicate whether the rule matched in the policy was in simulation mode
IdpPolicyFederationProvider
The provider of the federated authentication service. Only applies to federated access triggers.
Values:
ADFS (100)
PING_FEDERATE (101)
IdpPolicyRuleAction
A bit mask of the actions configured in the rule in the Identity Protection policy
Values:
ALLOW (0x1)
BLOCK (0x2)
MFA (0x4)
RESET_PASSWORD (0x8)
ADD_TO_WATCH_LIST (0x10)
APPLY_SSO_POLICY (0x20)
IdpPolicyRuleActionStatus
Specifies if the action was successfully applied, or an error message if it was not
Values:
SUCCESS (0x1)
FAILURE (0x2)
IdpPolicyMfaStatus
The status of the multi-factor authentication (MFA). Only applies to identity verification actions.
Values:
APPROVE (0x1)
DENY (0x2)
AUTO (0x4)
AUTO_APPROVE (0x5)
AUTO_DENY (0x6)
DENY_AND_NOT_FRAUD (0xA)
DENY_AND_FRAUDULENT (0x12)
INVALID_USER_INPUT (0x20)
USER_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT (0x40)
USER_NOT_ENROLLED (0x80)
ERROR (0x100)
NO_VALID_AUTHORIZER (0x280)
IdpPolicyMfaProvider
The provider of the multi-factor authentication (MFA). Only applies to identity verification actions.
Values:
DUO (0)
GOOGLE_AUTHENTICATOR (1)
RSA_AM (2)
RSA_CAS (3)
OKTA_VERIFY (4)
SYMANTEC_VIP (5)
AZURE_MFA (6)
RADIUS (7)
PING_ID (8)
CYBER_ARK (9)
ONE_LOGIN (10)
UNKNOWN (11)
NOT_APPLICABLE (12)
ENTRUST (13)
AZURE_AUTH (14)
FORGEROCK (15)

IdpPolicyMfaFactorType
A bit mask of the factor types available for multi-factor authentication (MFA) in the Identity Protection policy
Values:
PUSH (0x1)
OTP (0x2)
PUSH_WITH_OTP_FALLBACK (0x5)
CALL_OTP (0xA)
CALL_VERIFY (0x11)
SMS_1WAY (0x22)
SMS_2WAY (0x41)
DYNAMIC (0x80)
BIOMETRICS (0x101)
HARDWARE_OTP (0x202)
EMERGENCY_OTP (0x402)
CALL_VERIFY_WITH_PASSCODE (0x801)
UNKNOWN (0x1000)
NOT_APPLICABLE (0x2000)
GRID_CARD (0x4002)
PUSH_WITH_NUMBER_MATCHING (0x8001)
OIDC (0x10000)
IdpPolicyMfaFailModeAction
Values:
ALLOW (0)
BLOCK (1)
SourceAccountType
The type of the Active Directory bound with this activity.
Values:
USER (0)
COMPUTER (1)
GROUP (2)
CLOUD_SERVICE (3)
SourceAccountUserName
The username associated with this activity.
SourceAccountSamAccountName
The sAMAccountName value of the account bound with this activity.
Only set if available as part of the raw, sniffed data, and usually set alongside the SourceAccountDomain field.
For stronger identification, the SourceAccountObjectSid or SourceAccountObjectGuid fields are better foreign keys
- although they may not be available in some cases, such as authentication failures.
SourceAccountDomain
The domain that the account bound with this activity is a member of.
SourceAccountObjectSid
The objectSid value of the account bound with this activity.
SourceAccountObjectGuid
The objectGUID value of the account bound with this activity.
SourceAccountAzureId
The unique Azure userId value of the user associated with this activity
SourceAccountOktaId
The unique OKTA actor ID of the user associated with this activity
SsoEventSource
The source from which the activity data was retrieved. In the case of federated-SSO, this might be either the IDaaS
vendor or the federation provider, depending on the retrieval method.
Values:
AZURE (1)
OKTA (2)
AWS (3)
ADFS (100)
PING_FEDERATE (101)
OTHER (200)
AuthorizerAccountUserName
The username attribute of the authorizer account
AuthorizerAccountSamAccountName The sAMAccountName attribute of the authorizer account
AuthorizerAccountDomain
The domain of the authorizer account
AuthorizerAccountObjectSid
The objectSID attribute of the authorizer account
AuthorizerAccountObjectGuid
The objectGUID attribute of the authorizer account
AuthorizerAccountAzureId
The Azure ID of the authorizer account

710/1226
Field
Description
AuthorizerAccountOktaId
The OKTA ID of the authorizer account
SourceEndpointAddressIP4
The IP address of the endpoint from which this activity originates.
Mutually exclusive with the SourceEndpointAddressIP6 field.
SourceEndpointAddressIP6
The IP address of the endpoint from which this activity originates.
Mutually exclusive with the SourceEndpointAddressIP4 field.
SourceEndpointNetworkType
The network type to which the SourceEndpointAddressIP4 or SourceEndpointAddressIP6 value belongs,
depending on customer configuration.
Values:
INTERNAL (0x1)
VPN (0x2)
WIRELESS (0x4)
NAT (0x8)
PUBLIC (0x10)
UNKNOWN (0x20)
SourceEndpointNetworkTag
The network tag to which the SourceEndpointAddressIP4 or SourceEndpointAddressIP6 value belongs, depending
on customer configuration.
SourceEndpointHostName
The hostname of the source endpoint. Might originate either directly from the raw event data or from one of the host
association resolution methods.
When available, either the SourceEndpointAccountObjectSid or SourceEndpointAccountObjectGuid fields are
superior for use as foreign keys.
SourceEndpointAccountObjectSid
The objectSid value of the source endpoint account.
SourceEndpointAccountObjectGuid
The objectGUID value of the source endpoint account.
SourceEndpointIpReputation
The reputation attributes of the source IP (SourceEndpointAddressIP4 or SourceEndpointAddressIP6).
Only set for public addresses.
Values:
NONE (0x00)
ANONYMOUS_ACTIVE (0x01)
ANONYMOUS_SUSPECT (0x02)
ANONYMOUS_INACTIVE (0x04)
ANONYMOUS_PRIVATE (0x08)
ASSOCIATED_WITH_DICTIONARY_ATTACK (0x10)
ASSOCIATED_WITH_DDOS_ATTACK (0x20)
ASSOCIATED_WITH_SPAM (0x40)
HOSTING_FACILITY (0x80)
INTEL_MALICIOUS_HIGH (0x100)
LocationLongitudeAsInt
The location longitude value associated with the event.
The value is a 4-digit precision fixed-point value (11.1m) represented as a 64-bit integer.
Divide by 100,000 to get back the fixed-point value
LocationLatitudeAsInt
The location latitude value associated with the event.
The value is a 4-digit precision fixed-point value (11.1m) represented as a 64-bit integer.
Divide by 100,000 to get back the fixed-point value.
LocationAccuracyRadius
The reported accuracy radius for (LocationLatitudeAsInt, LocationLongitudeAsInt).
LocationCountryCode
The country-code associated with (LocationLatitudeAsInt, LocationLongitudeAsInt).
LocationStateCode
The state-code associated with (LocationLatitudeAsInt, LocationLongitudeAsInt).
LocationCityCode
The city-code associated with (LocationLatitudeAsInt, LocationLongitudeAsInt) as listed in the GeoNames
database.
SsoApplicationIdentifier
The human-readable target application identifier.
For stronger identification, use either the SsoApplicationUri field, or vendor-specific fields such as
AzureApplicationId.
SsoApplicationUri
The URL or URN of the target application.
IdpPolicyMfaProviderName
The third-party MFA provider used in the Cloud MFA (protocol based) integration.
